ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_kod_je: Cadastral unit code. Usually an identifier from the TERYT register or the Land and Buildings Register.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_sjr_ko: Unit type code indicating the type of feature, e.g. a voivodeship, district, commune or cadastral unit.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_nazwa_: Name of the administrative unit, e.g. Warsaw district.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_powier: Area of the unit recorded in the register, expressed in hectares.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_organ_: Information about the administrative authority responsible for the unit's data.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_kod__1: Attribute related to the unit code. Explains why the unit code has not been entered into the database.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_nazwa1: Attribute related to the unit name. Explains why the unit name has not been entered into the database.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_organ1: Attribute related to the unit's authority. Explains why the unit's authority has not been entered into the database.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_wazna_: Code indicating the validity status or state of the information about the unit.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.iip_przest: Namespace identifying the dataset in the National Register of Boundaries.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.iip_identy: Identifier of the spatial feature in the National Register of Boundaries.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_kj_iip: Namespace identifying the dataset, assigned by the dataset provider.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_kj_i_1: Local identifier of the spatial feature, assigned by the dataset provider.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_kj_i_2: Identifier of a specific version of the spatial feature, assigned by the dataset provider.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_sps_ko: Legal status of the territorial division unit.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_powi_1: Corrected area of the territorial division unit, expressed in hectares.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_kj_i_3: Attribute related to the namespace identifying the dataset. Explains why the namespace has not been entered into the database.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_jor_id: Foreign key column referencing PRGT_JEDNOSTKA_ORGANIZACYJNA. Identifier of the organizational unit in the National Register of Boundaries.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.wersja_od: Date when the feature version was introduced or modified in the dataset.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.wersja_do: Date when the feature version was retired from the dataset.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.wazny_od: Official date when the territorial division unit became legally effective.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.wazny_do: Official date when the territorial division unit ceased to be legally effective.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.iip_wersja: Identifier of a specific version of the spatial feature in the National Register of Boundaries. If the feature specification includes lifecycle information, the version identifier is used to distinguish individual versions of the feature.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_opis: Description of the territorial division unit.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.jpt_id: Primary key column in PRGT_JEDNOSTKA_PODZIALU_TERYTORIALNEGO. Identifier of the territorial division unit in the National Register of Boundaries.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.regon: REGON number of the territorial division unit.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.shape_leng: Length of the feature's geometry. For administrative units, this is usually the polygon's perimeter.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.shape_area: Geometric area of the territorial division unit's polygon.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.shape_le_1: Field containing the geometry length, created, for example, when exporting data from a GIS system.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.nazwa: Name of the locality, e.g. Kraków, Warsaw or Gdańsk.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.rodzaj: Type of locality, e.g. a village, city or settlement.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.liczbamies: Number of inhabitants of the locality.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.idprng: Identifier of the feature in the National Register of Geographical Names.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.wspgeog: Geographic coordinates of the locality in the WGS84 coordinate system.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.wspxy: Coordinates of the locality in the PL-1992 projected coordinate system.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.wojewodz: Voivodeship in which the feature is located.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.powiat: District in which the feature is located.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.gmina: Commune in which the feature is located.
ATTRIBUTE-DESCRIPTIONS.idgminy: Identifier of the commune in the National Register of Boundaries. Corresponds to the TERYT identifier.
